title: MCP Server Config
description: Generic, tool-agnostic connection info for one MCP server — a remote URL or a local (stdio) command, with optional auth. Two placeholder conventions apply, and they mean different things: ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default} is a reference something else resolves (from the environment, or by prompting) at install/connect time, used for headers, env, oauth.clientSecret and cwd — secrets MUST be written this way, never as literals; <name> is a value a human has to choose, used for args and other free strings, and nothing resolves it automatically. Per-tool derivation (including the outer mcpServers/servers wrapper, and any rewriting a target tool needs) is implemented as a registered transform function, not part of this schema — see ai-registry-core/src/mcp-config-templates/.

type.description: Remote transport. "streamable-http" matches the MCP spec name for the transport; "sse" is supported for legacy servers. Note that mcp.json-style client configs (Claude Code, VS Code and derivatives) spell Streamable HTTP as "http" — that spelling is deliberately not accepted here, so the registry has exactly one canonical value; translating to a tool's own spelling is a transform's job.

headers.description: Static header-based auth, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ${MY_TOKEN}"}. Token values must be ${VAR} references, never literal secrets.

oauth.description: OAuth 2.1 configuration. Presence (even as an empty object) signals the server supports/expects OAuth; omission means header-based or no auth. Only valid for HTTP-based transports; WebSocket is header-only. Redirect/callback handling is client-specific and deliberately not part of this schema.

clientId.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID. Omit to let the client attempt Dynamic Client Registration / CIMD. Note: a clientId bound to an exact-match redirect URI at the provider may not work from every client.

clientSecret.description: Client secret for confidential clients. MUST be a ${VAR} reference; literal secrets are rejected.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request, one token per entry. Transforms join with a space where the target client expects an RFC 6749 §3.3 scope string.

authServerMetadataUrl.description: URL of the authorization server metadata document (RFC 8414 or OIDC discovery), overriding the default discovery chain. Maps to Theia's oauth.authorizationServer.

resource.description: Resource indicator (RFC 8707) sent in the authorization request, for servers that require it.

type.description: WebSocket transport (legacy/push use cases). Authentication is header-only; OAuth is not supported on this transport.

headers.description: Static header-based auth, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ${MY_TOKEN}"}. Token values must be ${VAR} references, never literal secrets.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command. Values a user has to choose are written as <name> placeholders, e.g. "--prebuilt=<database>"; ${VAR} references belong in env, not here.

env.description: Environment variables for the server process. Secret values must be ${VAR} references, never literal secrets.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root; ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/${PLUGIN_DATA} references resolve against the plugin installation/data directory.
